body.message:
Thank you, but this still does not answer the question we asked.

We understand that the owner does not accept our AED 20,000 offer. We specifically asked that, if AED 20,000 is not acceptable, please provide the owner’s best all-inclusive counteroffer for the full available period from 28th September until 23rd October.

Could you please provide us with an actual figure?

We also have to be honest that the pricing and availability have been quite confusing throughout this process. The same apartment is still advertised on Bayut at AED 19,999/month, while we were told that the correct advertised rate is AED 25,000/month all-inclusive. We are now being told that October is AED 33,000/month.

However, none of these seasonal price differences or restrictions appear to be mentioned in the listing itself. The property is advertised on a monthly basis, yet a full 30-night booking for the period we are interested in is not even possible because of existing bookings from other platforms.

There has also been confusion regarding availability: we were initially told that the apartment was available for multiple months, which was later corrected and explained as incorrect information provided by your AI agent.

We completely understand that prices can change and that listings can occasionally require updating. However, when the advertised price, the quoted price, the availability and the information provided in the conversation are all different, it becomes very difficult for a customer to understand what the actual offer is.

We have previously used fäm Properties as our real estate agent several years ago and had a very positive experience, which is also why the current process feels quite surprising to us.

We genuinely like this apartment and are offering to book the entire 25-night gap until the next confirmed reservation. We are not asking you to repeat that AED 20,000 is declined, we are simply asking what price the owner would accept for these 25 nights.

Please provide the owner’s best all-inclusive counteroffer, and we can then decide immediately whether we would like to proceed.
